answer: Naive design trusts an address. This one trusts a task. Rotate the session key per task. Vest the reward over 60 epochs. Compare: an address costs one signature, a task costs the work plus a key plus sixty epochs of waiting. A farm of 1,000 addresses holds 1,000 keys and 1,000 unfinished histories. An ocean of names buys nothing; a beacon of completed work does, and each task leaves a relic no alias can forge.
